title: Intake
activation: a request carrying several concerns, corrections, or implied outcomes at once
a brain dump, a forwarded thread, meeting notes, asks outnumbering the sentences that state them
turn this into a plan without asking me to restate it
extract the plan, the corrections, the contradictions, what we actually do
standDown: a clear single-outcome request: add a button, rename the function, just do it
thinking out loud with no ask yet, roadmap musing
outcomes: an execution plan with primary outcome, constraints, decisions made, parking lot
inputs: the request as it arrived, unedited
minimumEvidence: every load-bearing claim cites what it rests on or is marked unverified
escalation: only a genuinely blocking question is asked; everything else proceeds on labeled assumptions
